id: title:Gilbert09:drop http status codes from source setup errors

review.posthog_relevance: Provides clearer, less technical error messages to warehouse users when RevenueCat ingestion fails, without exposing internal status codes or v2 secret key instructions.
review.reason: The change replaces 404, 401, and 403 error responses in the warehouse ingestion path with clearer instructions. This is a localized maintenance and UX improvement for warehouse users, not a systemic capability or critical reliability fix. No tier assignment is performed; only observations are returned.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is limited to message clarity; no change to query correctness, data integrity, or systemic risk reduction is demonstrated. The tier is assigned based on the conservative interpretation of the observed hunk, not on unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed; only observations are returned.

observations.behavior: Replaced the 404 error message to remove the parenthetical status code and the v2 secret API key instruction, retaining the core instruction to check the project ID.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides clearer, less technical error messages to warehouse users when a RevenueCat project is not found, without exposing internal status codes or v2 secret key instructions.

observations.behavior: Replaced the 401 error message to remove the v2 secret API key instruction and the Project settings path, retaining the core instruction to generate a new v2 secret API key and reconnect.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides clearer, less technical error messages to warehouse users when an API key is rejected, without exposing internal status codes or v2 secret key instructions.

observations.behavior: Replaced the 403 error message to remove the v2 secret API key instruction and the default permission hint, retaining the core instruction to give the v2 secret API key the permissions and reconnect.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides clearer, less technical error messages to warehouse users when a request is denied, without exposing internal status codes or v2 secret key instructions.
